summary: E-commerce/delivery app with Admin Panel, shop page, checkout, and user management features. Building out wallet system, delivery charge logic, and product display enhancements.
architectural_notes: Wallet logic must not interfere with Shop Open/Close toggle or Login system; prioritize login session on conflict.
Do not delete existing user tables; add wallet_balance as a new column to the user database.
known_issues: Customer Wallet System build failed (AI unable to complete); needs retry or rephrasing.

existing_features.title: Update the checkout page to display the delivery charge breakdown: show ₹5 delivery fee line item when the cart total is below ₹51 and distance is within 0.5km–1km, and show 'Free Delivery' when the order meets the ₹51 minimum. The final order total shown to the user must include the delivery charge where applicable.
On the shop/home page, display a small green text label 'Delivery in 10 Mins' directly below every product name in the product card component (ProductCard.tsx).

new_feature_requests.summary: Customer Wallet System: replace old Recharge module, add wallet_balance column, admin credit/debit UI, and Pay via Wallet button at checkout
Free delivery minimum order ₹51; delivery charge ₹5 for orders below ₹51 within 0.5km or 1km
Show small green text 'Delivery in 10 Mins' under every product name on the shop page

Add a delivery charge logic to the backend: if the order total is below ₹51, apply a ₹5 delivery charge for delivery distances of 0.5km or under 1km. Orders of ₹51 or above qualify for free delivery regardless of distance within that range.
